title: Block message echoes the original prompt, leaking the secret into the UI and transcript
reason_not_testable: Depends on UserPromptSubmit decision output (decision:block, suppressOriginalPrompt) and Claude Code's transcript writer. test-spec.md defines no prompt-hook component and no fixture kind that can express these outputs; prompt text cannot be a must_not_see source. Non-hook control: rotate the credential, do not treat a block as scrubbing the transcript, and apply disk retention policy.
